title: The instrument hash misses what a run reads: platform rules, prep, knobs
premise_notes: instrument.rs:1-4 doc promises moderation lists; compute hashes policy/local/*.txt (176-188) and never platform-rules.json; moderation.rs:466-475 Auto reads <char>/../../policy/platform-rules.json; BrainTuning default policy Auto (brain lib.rs:158); runner.rs instrument_with (391-408) passes no prep/platforms/knobs/judge; runner.rs:772 records only prep_label; daemon cli.rs:1346 sets stream_prep from prep::for_sim; runner.rs:1007 resolves judge tier per run; night-opus.toml:1-2 comment as cited; reconcile metrics.rs:280-283 keys (tone, instrument_hash). 9ca1dc2/5c38732 touched instrument.rs/runner.rs but added none of these entries - premise still holds. Body error: 'tournament::plan needs no logic change: a mismatched hash already plans Stale' is true only for instrument_hash entries (tone, and the proposed judge_tier); platform-rules/prep/knobs land in base_hash, which names the tournament directory (tournament.rs:3,168-169), so such an edit yields a new directory with every run New, not Stale.
floor_notes: M/6/8/5, 4 files, 6 cases. Gate: NOT irreversible - instrument.json and run dirs are never rewritten; changed base hashes create new tournament directories beside the old ones, reconcile keeps old cells under their old hash, and reverting restores the old hashes. One-time cost: an in-flight resumable tournament restarts from zero in a new dir (spend, not lost history) - the commit should say so. Write set shares runner.rs with sim-runner-judging A - serialize.
ambition_why: Closing the instrument-identity hole is what keeps every tournament result honest; the principal's move for a sim harness.
grounding_why: All cited lines hold at HEAD, but the card misreads how a base-hash change surfaces in plan.
falsifiability_why: Cases 1-5 are red today and pin each entry; case 6 as written (rules edit -> same-dir Run/Stale) contradicts the card's own design and would stay red after a correct build, pushing the builder to hack plan.
revision: Replace case 6 with: 'tournament::plan on a matrix with a complete run, then platform-rules.json edited -> plan.tournament_id differs from the first plan (new <matrix>-<base10> dir), every run is New, and the old tournament dir and its instrument.json are byte-unchanged (today: same tournament_id, run planned Skip/Complete)'.
reason: Real comparability bug, verified; the one case that tests the split targets the wrong mechanism.

premise_notes: __main__.py:82-83 globs and unlinks every *.png in --out (incl. depth.png); depth_map.py writes depth.png/depth.json into the same folder (510, 526) with sha256 inputs nobody reads (geom.ts checkDepthMeta checks version/size/near/far only); depth_map portrait adds lights as rgb*alpha and ignores gain/occl while split.compose_rest adds rgb*gain and occludes by alpha*occl; stage glow.ts:245 sets u_occl=0 for lights so cov=1, agreeing with compose_rest; load_rig reads folder/file with no FILE_RE check; no shadowrunr_rig import in tools/avatar. No commit since ed86c9f touched tools/. Impact note: since 5c38732 (merged in 9ca1dc2) DEFAULT_FACE is 'cut' (variants.ts:13), so a re-split silently disables the opt-in depth variant, not the default face - impact 8 is somewhat overstated.
